description: Managed device driver for the Lab Gruppen D Series Amplifier.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Lab Gruppen header, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Auto Connect button: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only after the amplifier answers, and an amplifier that stops answering is dropped and retried. Changing the IP address now reconnects without reloading.
